summary: The agent correctly identifies the regression task and builds an ensemble of LightGBM and CatBoost models using KFold cross-validation. However, it suffers from naive ensembling with an unoptimized 50/50 split. More critically, the preprocessing pipeline introduces data leakage by computing frequency and categorical encodings on the entire training set (and test set) before the cross-validation split, and the code fails to report any validation scores to actually evaluate model performance.
